verdict.rationale: The evidence shows n8n has its own documented API (a 'n8n API' docs page), but only the page title is evidenced, so its scope and any parity with the UI are unproven. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate docs paths, so no machine-readable spec confirms coverage. The CLI and MCP Server Trigger are separate features and are not credited here. Missing for 10: evidence of which UI operations the API covers (workflows, executions, credentials, users, source control, settings), an explicit UI–API parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
